cases.title: HCN training geometry and HCN/HNC transition geometry
cases.result: Two finite-budget two-start free-contraction comparisons. MACE-to-free gaps are 0.8033984204 mEh for the training HCN geometry and 30.0321905941 mEh for the transition geometry.
cases.limitation: The free endpoints satisfy the recorded coefficient-gradient criterion; they are not certified global minima.

cases.title: Rigid ethane torsion: MACE, free contraction and conventional bases
cases.result: 25 geometries, 0 to 120 degrees in 5-degree steps. Both free starts converged at every angle; 50 frozen bases were independently checked. Grid barriers: MACE 3.651135074 and free contraction 3.495155486 kcal/mol.
cases.limitation: Rigid scan, fixed exponents/core and 44 spherical AOs. It is not a relaxed torsional barrier or a global free-contraction limit.

cases.title: Ethane with a second carbon valence-p radial channel
cases.result: 25 checked geometries with 50 rather than 44 AOs. Fifteen angles were independently optimized and ten were transferred by exact reflection/atom permutation and rechecked. Free grid barrier: 3.133362078 kcal/mol.
cases.limitation: The 44-AO MACE checkpoint was not enlarged or retrained. Transferred points are not independent optimizations; no interpolation was used.

cases.title: Carbon valence s/p radial functions during ethane torsion
cases.result: Radial functions, coefficients and moments for C0 over 25 angles. The source reports maximum normalization error 4.44e-16 and analytic/quadrature moment difference 8.88e-16.
cases.limitation: These are normalized basis functions, not occupied molecular orbitals or electron densities. The interactive HTML is retained; browser interaction was not newly verified.

cases.title: Restricted-HF ethane C-C stretching stress test
cases.result: All 56 distances were processed; 51 free endpoints met the coefficient-gradient criterion. Five endpoints at 2.70, 2.75, 2.80, 2.85 and 2.90 Angstrom did not. Both valid and unconverged records/geometries are retained.
cases.limitation: This follows a restricted RHF branch with rigid methyl groups, not physical homolytic dissociation. The nonconverged interval and nearby branch changes must remain explicit.

cases.title: Fixed STO-6G polarization controls on the ethane torsion scan
cases.result: 75 new SCFs for STO-6G, STO-6G+C(d), and STO-6G+C(d)+H(p), all passed. Combined tables contain 11 methods/bases over 25 geometries.
cases.limitation: The augmented STO-6G bases are explicitly defined custom controls, not a unique standard STO-6G* or STO-6G**. Absolute-energy and relative-curve quality are separate.

cases.title: Atomic radial density, S22 counterpoise and static polarizability
cases.result: 284 attempted cases: 272 passed, 12 failed. All 35 NNAO cases passed. Failures are ma-def2-QZVPP GPU-memory errors: ten S22 dimers and two polarizabilities. Atomic cases 36/36; CP 166/176; polarizability 70/72.
cases.limitation: Polarizabilities hold the predicted basis fixed under the field. Atomic charge/spin states extrapolate from neutral closed-shell molecular training. Shared-subset S22 statistics must not be described as complete QZ coverage.

cases.title: Repaired representative S66x8, HB300SPXx10 and BH9 comparisons
cases.result: Canonical merged report: 852/852 passed (S66x8 288, HB300SPXx10 360, BH9 204 species), yielding 54 reaction/basis profiles. Independent energies 31/31, maximum error 2.09184e-11 Eh; 13 selected internal-stability checks passed.
cases.limitation: Only the 242-case repair subset received the specified native real-internal-stability checks. Global HF minima and external spin/complex stability are not certified. BH9 connectors are schematic R/TS/P levels, not IRC paths; no ZPE/thermal terms. HF lacks correlated dispersion.

cases.title: Frozen 500-system model inference on 18 historical relative energies
cases.result: 39 structures, two frozen coefficient predictions per structure: native and independent energy checks each passed 78/78. Maximum native/reference difference: 7.6738615462e-12 Eh. Eighteen relative energies span reaction, barrier and noncovalent categories.
cases.limitation: This is not full GMTKN55 or WTMAD2. Binding here is positive (monomer sum minus dimer), without CP; curve examples use negative interaction energies. Earlier 200-system models differ in data, pools, core assets and architecture.

cases.title: Nine S/M/L x SZP/DZP/TZP finite-budget free-contraction diagnostics
cases.result: Seven structures x nine families = 63 independently checked cases. Four starts per case have different optimizer outcomes retained in the status table. Maximum independent energy difference: 3.93106e-9 Eh.
cases.limitation: Historical numerical core6 and candidate pools differ from the later BSE-reference-core cohort. Many starts reached budgets or were rejected. S/M/L pools are not strictly nested; this is not a global basis-capacity limit. TZP adds valence radial columns, not the angular structure of cc-pVTZ.

cases.title: Historical 500-system training loss and logarithmic energy-change trends
cases.result: History reaches epoch 596; the saved update 5969 is a partial epoch 597. Epochs 5-596 supply 592 complete online means. Epoch 4 is missing, and epochs 0-3 use the earlier full-evaluation policy.
cases.limitation: Online means combine pre-update energies at ten parameter versions. They are not final-vector full-set scores, best-model criteria or CBS errors. The evaluation checkpoint used in recent examples is update 3351, not update 5969.

cases.title: Early methane contraction optimization and conventional-basis comparisons
cases.result: Original optimization records and fixed-geometry AO/Hamiltonian-size/energy comparisons are preserved as separate historical source runs.
cases.limitation: Prototype basis/core/pool and network definitions differ from the later 500-system model. These rows must not be relabelled as update-3351 results.
cases.method: Legacy HF/NNAO prototype settings; retain each source run separately

cases.title: Earlier aniline GPU4PySCF conventional-basis comparison
cases.result: Original single-geometry basis-size and total-energy tables; the final comparison includes a 98-AO trained NNAO basis and conventional minimal-to-triple-zeta controls.
cases.limitation: This older model and cc-pVQZ-JKFIT auxiliary basis differ from the update-3351/def2-universal-jkfit cohort. The single aniline example does not establish generalization.
cases.method: DF-RHF; final GPU4PySCF comparison uses cc-pVQZ-JKFIT

notes: Data-only handoff; no manuscript files are edited.
Cases retain their actual checkpoint/core/pool/auxiliary identities; do not pool unlike cohorts.
The repaired merged results in case 08 are canonical; superseded reports remain explicitly separate.
Ongoing-training context is a dated configuration/status snapshot, not completed study results.
